summary: Axon Enterprise filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, detailing its September 18 issuance of $1.15 billion aggregate principal amount of 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, including the full $150 million over-allotment exercise. The notes carry no regular interest, mature September 15, 2031, and have an initial conversion price of approximately $652.06 per share (1.5336 shares per $1,000 principal). Conversion is conditional before June 15, 2031. This is an ordinary convertible debt financing, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, or M&A terms are stated.
